app.name: dse-alerts
theme.title: Theme
footer.notice: Automated observations about prices, volumes and filings on the Dhaka Stock Exchange. Not investment advice; no buy or sell recommendation is implied. Runs entirely on this server; the browser talks only to it.
demo.hint: A shared, read-only account with a sample watchlist and portfolio. No sign-up.
demo.banner: You are browsing the shared demo account, which is read-only.
demo.readonly: The demo account is read-only. Create your own account to add symbols, change rules or save settings.
login.title: Log in
login.note: Accounts live only in this installation's own database.
register.title: Create an account
register.note: The email is where alerts are sent. Nothing is sent anywhere else.
register.exists: That email already has an account. Log in instead.
error.not_code: {symbol} is not a DSE trading code
dash.title: Overview
dash.nothing_fired: Nothing fired on your symbols this session.
dash.add_placeholder: Add a trading code, e.g. GP
dash.nothing_watched: Nothing watched yet. Add a trading code above, or import holdings with
ai.title: AI summary
ai.by: Written by {provider} from the alerts above. Descriptions only, never advice.
ai.off: Off. Put a free Groq key in .env as GROQ_API_KEY (or an OpenRouter or Anthropic key) and the next run writes a short note about your alerts.
ai.none_yet: No summary for this session yet. One is written during the daily run, or when you check alerts now.
ai.no_alerts: Nothing fired this session, so there is nothing to summarise.
portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.sub: Valued at the close of {date}. Positions as imported; quantities and costs come from your statements.
portfolio.none: No holdings yet. Put them in a CSV (account,symbol,quantity,avg_cost) and run
portfolio.history_title: Book value vs cost, last 250 sessions
portfolio.history_note: Today's quantities priced at each session's close: what this book was worth, not a performance record.
targets.title: Targets
targets.sub: Companies you are considering. Each row shows what is true about the stock right now, from its own history; click through for the full picture.
targets.none: No targets yet. Add a trading code above, or mark a watched symbol as a target from its page.
symbol.true_note: Each panel compares today with this stock's own history (since 2013 where available). Descriptions, not predictions.
symbol.vs_dsex: {symbol} vs DSEX, indexed to 100 one year ago
symbol.no_fund: No company page on DSE for this code (funds, bonds), or run
symbol.circuit_hits: Upper / lower circuit hits per year
symbol.rules_note: Defaults are calibrated on this stock's own history. Untick a rule to silence it; fill a field to override. Percentages are plain numbers (5 = 5%).
fact.ret20_note: {where} ({p05} to {p95}). DSEX {dsex} over the same sessions.
fact.volume_note_p95: vs its 20-session average; {p95}x is this stock's 95th percentile.
fact.range_note: Low {low}, high {high}; 0% is the low, 100% the high.
fact.circuit_note_avg: This stock averages {up} upper / {down} lower hits a year.
alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.sub: Everything that fired on your symbols, newest first. The same list goes out by email and Telegram.
alerts.none: No alerts recorded yet. They appear here after each daily run, or after "Check alerts now" on the overview.
scorecard.title: Scorecard
scorecard.sub: What happened after the alerts you were sent: the stock's move 5 and 20 sessions later, DSEX over the same sessions, and the backtest's expectation. It grades the rules, not you. {total} alerts, {pending} pending (fewer than 20 sessions since).
rules.title: Rules
rules.sub: Every rule states a fact about the latest session. "Fires per stock-year" and "what followed" come from the backtest on 2013–2026 history (floor-price period excluded). They describe the past, not the future.
rule.big_drop.name: Big drop
rule.big_drop.desc: Fell more than the stock's own 5th-percentile move over N sessions (or your % if set); once per episode
rule.big_rise.name: Big rise
rule.big_rise.desc: Rose more than the stock's own 95th-percentile move over N sessions (or your % if set); once per episode
rule.upper_circuit.name: Upper circuit
rule.upper_circuit.desc: Closed at the daily upper price limit
rule.lower_circuit.name: Lower circuit
rule.lower_circuit.desc: Closed at the daily lower price limit
rule.volume_spike.name: Volume spike
rule.volume_spike.desc: Volume at least 3x (or the stock's 95th percentile) with a 3%+ move
rule.new_250d_high.name: New 250-session high
rule.new_250d_high.desc: Closed above the highest high of the previous 250 sessions
rule.new_250d_low.name: New 250-session low
rule.new_250d_low.desc: Closed below the lowest low of the previous 250 sessions
rule.vs_index.name: Diverged from DSEX
rule.vs_index.desc: Moved at least 5 points more or less than the index on the day
rule.psi_news.name: Price-sensitive news
rule.psi_news.desc: The company filed price-sensitive information in the last 2 days
rule.record_date.name: Record date soon
rule.record_date.desc: A dividend record date falls within the next 3 days
rule.ma_cross.name: 50-session average cross
rule.ma_cross.desc: The close crossed its 50-session moving average
rule.pe_level.name: P/E level
rule.pe_level.desc: P/E at or below your maximum, or at or above your minimum (fires when it becomes true)
rule.illiquid.name: Thin trading
rule.illiquid.desc: No trades in 5 or more of the last 10 sessions (fires when it becomes true)
al.circuit_detail_hits: This stock hits the {side} circuit about {hits} times a year.
al.illiquid: {symbol} had no trades in {n} of the last 10 sessions
al.illiquid_detail: Thin trading means the quoted price may not be achievable in size.
settings.title: Settings
settings.digest: Include the written AI summary when a provider is configured
settings.language: Language for pages, emails and Telegram
settings.email_off: not configured; alerts go to data/outbox/
email.title: DSE alerts for session {date}
email.nothing: Nothing fired for your {n} watched symbols.
email.portfolio_line: Value Tk {value} ({dpct} today, {dchg}); P&L {pnl} ({pnlpct}) on cost Tk {cost}
email.disclaimer: These alerts are automated observations about prices, volumes and filings on the Dhaka Stock Exchange. They are not investment advice and no buy or sell recommendation is implied.
tg.title: DSE alerts, session {date}
